summary: Enterprise Health Engine (D122) + Formula Registry (D151) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed covering summary payload, 11 domains sorted asc, alert correctness (score<80, severity critical<60, cause/impact/1-3 actions/estimated_effect), history snapshot, formulas list (11 active, v>=1, no _id), explain (calc_steps with value/subscore/weight/contribution_pts, pos/neg contributors, confidence), PATCH validations (missing reason 400, unknown metric 400, negative weight 400, warn<=critical 400, zero-sum weights 400), edit->version bump->audit entry->rollback->weights restored, regression /api/admin/operations + /api/admin/business-health still 200. Frontend: /admin/enterprise-health renders overall score (59 Critical), all 11 domain cards sorted asc (9..94), 9 alert cards, expanding knowledge shows explain (3 calc-step rows) + editor (3 weights + warn + reason + save). Registry left CLEAN — every PATCH was rolled back.
critical_code_review_comments: enterprise_health.py: _collect_metrics() gates review_freshness at 100 if any 30d review exists else 40 — binary jump; consider proportional scoring to reflect target=100.

PATCH weights loop iterates over payload.get('weights') AFTER already looping over f['inputs'] to build new_inputs — validation of unknown metric happens after inputs are built (works, but could short-circuit earlier for clarity).

In _get_formulas() the seed writes doc without _id but reads doc from mongo which will include _id; the list_formulas endpoint correctly excludes it, but internal callers get raw docs with ObjectId — not currently serialized, safe today but fragile.
Frontend EnterpriseHealthPage.jsx swallows errors silently (console.error only) with no user-visible error state — if API returns 5xx the page stays on 'Se calculează…' spinner forever.
